sloka: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चर्या मया कृता ।नोपाश्नीयां फलं तस्या दुष्टेयं यदि मैथिली ।। ७.९६.२० ॥
transliteration: bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścaryā mayā kṛtā ।nopāśnīyāṁ phalaṁ tasyā duṣṭeyaṁ yadi maithilī ।। 7.96.20 ॥

translations.english: If this Maithili were impure, I would not partake of the fruit of the penance that I have performed for many thousands of years.
